name: Engine_SetSavedValue
comment: Stores the dword that Engine_SaveGame writes after the module hooks

name: IMuse_SaveToTemp
comment: Lua SaveIMuse: writes the sound module's save hook output to grim.tmp

name: IMuse_RestoreFromTemp
comment: Lua RestoreIMuse: stops all sounds, feeds grim.tmp to the sound module's restore hook, deletes the file
Sound module save callback taking a write function
Sound module restore callback taking a read function

name: Render_GetBackBuffer
comment: Returns the back buffer surface g_BackBuffer
Back buffer surface record (0xd8 bytes) that the engine draws into
Primary (visible) DirectDraw surface record

name: Render_ToggleDebugOverlay
comment: Flips debug flag 1 and, when turning it off, invalidates the whole canvas on every buffer

name: Render_SetFlipCallback
comment: Installs the function Render_Present calls to show the back buffer
Function that presents the back buffer, called by Render_Present

name: sputRender_SyncCamera
comment: Selects the setup's colormap, binds the rdCamera (setup+0x48) to the canvas, sets zoom 1.0 and updates it from the camera frame at setup+0x50 (300-byte setup records start at set+0xac)

name: Set_SwitchSetup
comment: Makes setupIdx current: applies its camera, copies its frame into the camera actor, blits the background bitmap into g_pBackgroundSurface and the depth bitmap into g_pZBufferSurface (clearing it when absent), draws the object states and invalidates the view
Non-zero when the depth buffer surface is created and used
Number of display buffers whose dirty rectangles must be tracked

name: MarkDirtyRect
comment: Aligns x/width to 4 pixels and marks the rectangle dirty on every buffer

name: Engine_CreateCameraActor
comment: Creates the hidden actor that carries the camera frame (g_hCameraActor)
Handle of the hidden camera actor

name: sputRender_SetDisplay
comment: Creates the rdCanvas, the background, temp and z-buffer surfaces, programs the pixel format into RDroid and draws the current set
RDroid canvas the 3D scene is rendered on
Scratch surface used when converting compressed backgrounds
Current setup's background image
Current setup's 16-bit depth image
Set whose background is currently prepared for drawing
Setup index whose background is currently prepared for drawing

name: sputRender_Update
comment: sputRender.cpp: draws one frame. Mode 3 polls the movie; otherwise re-prepares the set when it changed, draws object states, actors (profile slots 4-7), overlays, the iris/fade (flag 4 of g_dwRenderFlags) and text

name: Render_Present
comment: Calls the flip callback unless the frame was flagged to skip presentation

name: Render_SetPixelFormat
comment: Copies the 7-dword pixel format and pushes each component shift/mask into RDroid

name: Render_InitColorConstants
comment: Builds the 16-bit colour constants (black, white, greys, red, green, blue, text colours) for the current pixel format
Debug overlay bits: 1 overlay on, 2 draw sectors, 4 draw actor boxes
Render state bits: 2 no depth image, 4 fade in progress, 8 fade finished
